title: Recorded speech BCI trials
sourceStudy: Willett et al., A high-performance speech neuroprosthesis (2023)
signalDescription: Spike-band power, 256 channels, originally binned at 20 ms. For this display, frames are sampled every 40 ms and log-scaled to heatmap contrast.
decoderDescription: Real-time RNN and n-gram partial/final text outputs recorded during the experiment.
indexing: MATLAB 1-based inclusive epochs converted to Python [first-1:last]; partial timestamps relative to first go-period bin.
